reviews.title: Ai Assistant is on Crack
reviews.text:
AI Assistant Is on Crack

I paid for a full year of Brite because I genuinely loved this app. At this point, I regret paying annually because the AI Assistant, one of the biggest reasons I subscribed, is practically unusable.

The AI feels like it is sober once a week. Every now and then it suddenly works beautifully, reminds me why I loved Brite, and then it disappears back into endless “high demand” errors and becomes useless again.

This is not an occasional glitch anymore. It is a reliability problem with a paid feature.

What makes this worse is the complete lack of customer support. I have emailed Brite repeatedly about the AI failures, including messages specifically about my paid annual subscription, and I have received no response.

Meanwhile, Brite is still publishing updates and new content publicly.

So somebody is home.

Apparently just nobody who answers paying customers.

I should not have to chase a company across email, social media, App Store reviews, and possibly send a carrier pigeon to Armenia just to get a human response about a product I already paid for.

The planner itself is genuinely good, which makes this situation even more ridiculous. Brite built something I loved enough to purchase for an entire year and then paired it with an AI Assistant that works whenever the planets align and support that might as well be staffed by ghosts.

I did not purchase a lottery ticket for occasional access to AI.

I purchased a yearly subscription to a functioning product.

If Brite fixes the AI reliability problem and starts responding to customers, I will happily update this review.

Until then, one star is generous for a paid AI feature that seems to be sober once a week.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Don’t be fooled by “all the colorful options” this app / company promises.  Yes, it looks like it’s going to be impressive at first.  Keep looking.  I was willing to give it a try, but not sure I love what I was seeing of the product itself anyway - cluttered, inconsistent, not well-explained, and not at all intuitive.  But then while I was still trying to navigate through setup, they charged me $70 on day 1 of the free trial.  Refunded it when requested and promised free lifetime Pro for their mistake - the ChatBot, I assume. Now I can’t confirm that was done. Chat won’t respond - just says there’s a technical difficulty and try later.  Filled out a help request on the app which said they’d respond to by email, and when I hit send, it sent it to chat with the same non-response!  Desktop version won’t recognize the email and password used to set up phone app.  Starting to think their entire setup is a scam, especially if charging people fraudulently is a pattern and most of them don’t bother to ask for it back.

In the end, I had to screenshot the convo and will be contacting my bank to prevent future charges.

reviews.title: Premium Subscriber Issues - Unable to access data or use app
reviews.text:
***UPDATE JUNE 11, 2026*** (initial 1 star review continues from June 3rd…)

I’ve been a Premium Annual Subscriber for over a year now. As someone who has ADHD and a child with autism, this app was amazing. When it was functional. I experienced several glitches over the months such as tasks or notes not saving, or when trying to edit something it froze and kicked me out, only to have lost all progress once I restarted the app. 

That being said, I tried outsmarting the bugs every now and then, screenshotting something of my notes in the case I lost it all (which I shouldn’t have to do…), and I’m glad I was able to save a couple things. Sadly, a majority I did not. Couple weeks ago the app lost all functionality and will not allow me to access ANYTHING on the app. Including my profile settings. Even after installing the latest update. It won’t open or view anything… There are many critical and personal financial logs, notes, diary entries, projects, etc that I need access to immediately. 

I reached out to customer support (as suggested via email) day or two after it failed to let me access my data. No response. Followed up a week later (couple days ago as of 6/11/26), still nothing. Messaged on Facebook. Nothing. Wrote a review on here (initially 6/3/26) and Facebook (which I never do, but since it looked like a majority of Brite responding was more prompt to those leaving 1 star negative reviews) in hopes that would facilitate and expedite my inquiries. Nada. 

Now I see constant update posts being funneled on Facebook. I understand sometimes various team members may have different tasks or whatever the case may be, I understand that. But as someone who helps contribute financial support to an app that is suppose to be helpful… the least someone could do is touch base. A little communication goes a long way. I just want to know I haven’t lost everything and my data is still synced to their servers so I can retrieve it. 

I would HIGHLY recommend doing some research BEFORE committing to ANY kind of subscription with the app, at least until they can be more reliable and organized. As much as I have truly loved everything the app has to offer and have put extensive dedication and work into it… it’s discouraging and frankly frustrating that there has been no amount of accountability or assistance to resolve any issues to the lack of consistent reliable functionality and my inaccessibility of this app. 

As great as this app could be, I think the focus needs to be less on continually pushing updates and AI and prioritizing that basic functionality of the app itself is sound and reliable… and possibly a bit better communication. Especially for those who are financially supporting your app…

Unfortunately at this time, I will be cancelling my subscription until I’ve been given any kind of reassurance things will be made right. I’ve been extremely patient and hopeful, but it only extends for so long. Sorry for the long wind but had to express my frustration and hopefully spare someone from experiencing the same thing. Thank you for coming to my rant sesh. God bless 🙏🏻

reviews.title: Along With High Hopes, Discovered Equal Parts Potential & Problems!
reviews.text:
First, I should start off by saying that I really wanted to love this app as the concept simply can’t be beat, however I just can’t say the same for its execution. The idea of eliminating a dozen or more disparate apps in exchange for a single daily driver is nothing short of alluring, yet that’s an incredible challenge being that your customer base is not only expecting one high quality app, but essentially an entire suite of them! 

Now, the app does include nearly every feature that I could ask for in a robust daily planner, but it doesn’t appear as if their QA process is able to catch many smaller (and a couple of the larger) bugs before pushing a release out to the public. Additionally, we have come to expect integrations to work out-of-the-box, yet there were issues when pulling in my existing Google Calendar. Sadly, I have not experienced such issues with other apps, even those that appeared far less sophisticated. That’s never a good look for a paid, commercial app.

I do believe that this app has massive potential, so I will list a brief overview of some of the bugs and concerns that I experienced in just the first 24 hours. If these could be consistently addressed going forward, I am still willing to giving it another go and changing my rating accordingly.

1.  Before starting on the technical issues, I was directed to a Russian (.ru) payment gateway directly via the app menu. I get that multiple payment systems are needed in some apps, but this appeared rather sketchy! 
2.  After connecting my Google Calendar, I could only see a limited amount of past and future scheduled events! That makes no sense as it’s something people regularly need access to! 
3.  Select fields such as preexisting addresses were missing from my Google Calendar and it’s not practical to have to add them back in by hand! 
4.  The schedule would display “It seems, your schedule is overlapping,” however that particular event had both a start and stop time, no events immediately before or after it, and this was an event from my Google Calendar. 
5.  I accidentally tapped the focus timer at the bottom of the above event, but I could not get it to cancel no matter what I tried! Tapping “Continue” and “Remove” did absolutely nothing, even restarting the app did not help. 
6.  When trying to initially tweak my homepage, I had to manually refresh to see the changes, even simple ones like changing the icons to individual sections! That’s an extremely easy item to code and something that most people would expect to be automated. I initially thought it simply was not working at all until trying the manual refresh! 
7.  I don’t know if it’s a bug, but it just feels incomplete as tapping on any day in the weather doesn’t return details. I was expecting to see something as weather conditions change throughout the day.

This is where I will have to stop as I’m running out of space to complete this review. I do want to reiterate that there’s some things that I really do like a lot. The list options, especially having ADHD-friendly ones is nothing short of awesome! If the bugs could get worked out, especially those dealing with integrations (and I only tried one), this could be an outstanding daily driver!

Additionally, what’s up with a .ru payment page being in the app?! 🤔

reviews.title: Finally found the perfect app
reviews.text:
I have downloaded at least 40 different “productivity” apps. Calander/to-do lists/habits/notes etc. I’ve paid for a ton of apps searching for the right one for me. How Brite didn’t come up on many of my searches until now I will never know. 

This is everything I’ve wanted and more. It syncs with my Google Calendar and the functions work well for my adhd brain. I love having all my things in one place and that I can use this on my laptop as well. I spend my mornings on the app doing gratitude journaling and mood tracking. Setting up the time block (time mapping?)  of my day. I use the pomodoro clock often. I have so much room for customization that I can’t see ever needing another app.

reviews.title: Time will tell
reviews.text:
*update after using for 3 day trial. 

The concept and structure of this app is exactly what I need to plan my life. There is no other app that has this daily structure. For that it gets 5 stars. 

Unfortunately I take away 2 stars because it’s too glitchy. Its offerings are wide but not deep. Nearly every widget is lacking in consistent functionality. 

I hate to even say this because I’m really rooting for this app. The idea is there. I’d gladly pay triple the cost if it worked well. But it seems stuck in an early prototype phase. Too much friction for me to justify the cost. 

I’ll be keeping an eye on you, Brite. I hope you can find the funding and expertise to make this the app it deserves to be.

reviews.title: This app is everything I’ve been searching for.
reviews.text: I don’t usually leave reviews but this one was kind of personal. I’ve used just about every productivity app known to man and this one might just be my favorite thus far. It has everything I was searching for in a productivity app & touches many areas of life. I started using this app when I was a really bad space mentally & emotionally. I was severely depressed and felt like my life was spiraling out of control & I could not keep up. I started journaling in it, reading the quotes & helpful articles, I put my vision board there, started meditating & tracking my habits. It truly helped me regain a sense of control in my life. I recommend it to anyone who has ADHD, is stressed and overwhelmed, or anyone who just wants to regain control of their lives. i love this app.

reviews.title: Please fix this😭
reviews.text:
Hello developers. I want to say a huge thank you for this app. Among many complicated and inconvenient planning apps, I finally found everything I need without unnecessary features here in Brite.

But guys, the app is very buggy, suffering from many silly glitches. The most annoying thing is when I want to plan my day with events and, for example, I set the first event from 6:00 to 8:40, and the second from 8:40 to 10:40, the app says "it seems your events overlap," and this message covers the time of the second event. Moreover, this doesn't get fixed; specifically, on that day, even the event from 6:00 to 8:40 supposedly overlaps with the event from 10:40 to 18:00, lol — obviously, that’s nonsense.

Also, it shocked me that when I paste text from iPhone notes, it is inserted in black in the app, and I have a dark theme in the app, which is obviously inconvenient. In general, there are many small, silly, and not obvious bugs in the notes system as well as in the whole app.

Don't get me wrong, for me Brite is the perfect planner and I want to use it every day, it looks gorgeous, including the interface, but these little bugs just ruin the whole fun of the process, waste my time, and are simply terribly annoying...

I would really like to buy a subscription, but as long as these errors bother me, I do not want to. I beg you, please fix this.
